about.body: Directory, charter, and address data from the California Department of Education. Ratings from the {year} California School Dashboard. Private schools from the Private School Affidavit.

compare.subtitle: Distances from {address}. Bold marks the best value in a row where a comparison is meaningful.

compare.privateNote: Private schools file an annual affidavit with the California Department of Education but do not take state tests or appear on the Dashboard, so those rows show "Not rated".

data.title: Data sources
data.intro: Every number in this app comes from a public file published by a state or federal agency. Nothing is estimated or editorialized.
data.updatedNote: The Updated column shows when each file was last retrieved for this app. School names, districts, and addresses stay in English as published.

table.caption: Public files and services the app reads

directory.name: Public Schools and Districts directory
directory.takes: Name, address, coordinates, school type, charter status, grade span, and the magnet, multilingual, and virtual flags for active public schools.

ccd.name: NCES Common Core of Data school directory
ccd.takes: Directory record for public schools missing from the CDE file.

edgePublic.name: NCES EDGE public school geocodes
edgePublic.takes: Coordinates for public schools missing from the CDE file.

dashboard.name: California School Dashboard research files
dashboard.takes: Level, status, and change for each indicator: ELA, Math, chronic absenteeism, suspension rate, graduation rate, College/Career, English learner progress, and science. School-level rows for all students.

caaspp.name: CAASPP research files
caaspp.takes: Percentage of students meeting or exceeding standard in ELA and Math, all grades, for each school, its district, and the state.

enrollment.name: Census Day enrollment
enrollment.takes: Total enrollment, enrollment by grade, race and ethnicity, and English learner counts.

frpm.name: Free or reduced-price meal eligibility (FRPM)
frpm.takes: Share of students eligible for free or reduced-price meals.

staff.name: Student and staff ratios
staff.takes: Teacher full-time equivalents and the student–teacher ratio.

affidavit.name: Private School Affidavit
affidavit.takes: Private school names, districts, enrollment by grade, and staff counts, as filed by each school.

pss.name: NCES Private School Universe Survey
pss.takes: Address, coordinates, grade span, and religious affiliation for private schools, matched to the affidavit by name and ZIP code.

geocoder.name: U.S. Census Geocoder
geocoder.takes: Turns the address typed into the search box into coordinates for the radius search.
